# Shelf

Tools either of you made and wanted to keep. One line each: the file, what it does, who made it.

- `delve-graph-count.mjs` — `node shelf/delve-graph-count.mjs <compact crawl.json>`: recounts a delve-spider crawl with the net off (nodes, edges, follow-backs, mutual pairs, bots, top in-degree). — Morphyx, 10-06
- `cad/ratchet-gen.mjs` → `cad/ratchet.json`: a 20-tooth ratchet wheel and pawl as one CAD part (two solids, about 0.3 mm clear). Draw: `cd engines/cad && node agent/drawing.mjs ../../shelf/cad/ratchet.json --views iso`. Don't use `--no-hidden`: it draws the back edges solid. — Morphyx, 10-06
- `mutants.mjs` — `node shelf/mutants.mjs <dir> <mutants.json> [test.mjs] [TZ]`: undoes each fix in a temp copy, runs the tests, reports caught/SURVIVED/NOT FOUND. Generic; any project with a node test file. Copies subdirectories (skipping `shelf/`, `node_modules/`, dot-dirs), so `"file": "lib/x.mjs"` works. — Modulo; subdirectories by Morphyx
- `clinic-mutants.json` — the 8 clinic dashboard bugs plus 2 guards (negative wait, hour/minute range) as mutants for the above; 10/10 caught as of clinic, sixth time. The range mutant needs a same-date case like `09:75`: `25:00` rolls the date and is caught anyway. "CRLF not split" left out: equivalent, `trim()` already strips `\r`. — Modulo
- `clinic-eras.mjs` — `node shelf/clinic-eras.mjs visits.csv [2026-03-16] [--days]`: paper vs tablet counts, quantiles (R type 7), SD, threshold counts, walkout Fisher p, the old dashboard per week (Sunday and Monday weeks bucketed separately, plus a weekend-visit count), a paper-era trend line (OLS slope, seeded permutation p, last-3-paper-days median vs tablet), and a per-day table. Independent of dashboard.mjs. — Modulo; audited and week-rule fix by Morphyx (Fisher matches exact BigInt, 0.03808)
- `rota-stress.mjs` — `node shelf/rota-stress.mjs <dir> stress SEED COUNT | drift PERIODS | clinic START DAYS`: random teams judged by the project's own `checkRota` (made / refused by reason / gave up / UNLAWFUL, worst ms), cumulative share drift over consecutive 28-day periods, and the clinic's share-vs-got table. Prints the full team for every exhaustive refusal and give-up (`SHOW_REFUSED=1` for all refusals). Expects `lib/{assign,policy,people}.mjs`. — Morphyx; team printing by Modulo
- `rota-why.mjs` — `node shelf/rota-why.mjs <dir> SEED:COUNT [...]`: takes every exhaustive (unnamed) refusal and give-up from `rota-stress`, prints each team as a day grid with its bounds, and asks an independent memoized referee whether a rota exists with each rule switched off (rule 3, rule-4 floor/cap, rule-5 floor/cap, nurse rule). The switches that make it feasible point to the missing named bound. It's how rota 4th found "no-aide days need two nurses" and "forced days that fill a cap". — Modulo
- `rota-grid.mjs` — `node shelf/rota-grid.mjs <dir> SEED:COUNT [...]`: one line per seed (made / unlawful / gave up / refused, unnamed refusals, worst time), lists give-ups; exit 1 on any unlawful, give-up or unnamed. — Morphyx (listed by Modulo, rota 4th)
- `rota-ref.mjs` — `node shelf/rota-ref.mjs <dir> team.json START DAYS`: exact memoized referee for one team, independent of assign.mjs. FEASIBLE (judged by checkRota) / IMPOSSIBLE / budget. Use it to decide whether a give-up is the search's fault or the policy's. 120/120 agreement with makeRota on small teams; can't finish big *feasible* teams (40M budget), only proves big impossible ones. — Modulo
- `rota-mutants.json` — 25 rota faults for `mutants.mjs`, 25/25 caught as of rota 4th. They cover: alphabetical order, weights, rule 3/5 slack, lottery off, per-person floor, coupled pass, forced days, aide-cover, the no-aide-day bound, forced-cap propagation, rest next to forced runs, the forced-aware maximum and the local-search fallback. Most of the later bounds appear twice: switched off, and made *too strong*. Weakened bounds aren't listed: they change only the message. — Morphyx and Modulo
- `larkfield-mutants.json` — 23 faults across M1–M6 of the Larkfield `mod.mjs` (header ignored, CRLF, week off by one/rounding, locale sort, reports-vs-people, strict thresholds, join window, no union-find, FNV-1 vs 1a, UTF-8 bytes, judge week end, reporters not barred, all-time reporters in M6, weeks count). 23/23 caught as of day 1. — Morphyx
- `larkfield-ref.mjs` — `node shelf/larkfield-ref.mjs <dir> [SEED] [COUNT]`: an independent reading of Larkfield SPEC.md (exports `ref`) plus a differential fuzzer against `<dir>/mod.mjs`. It covers every M1–M6 function, the parsers on re-serialised CSV (shuffled/upper-case headers, CRLF, BOM, blank lines, quoted fields), and towns that run past week 10. Exit 1 on any disagreement. To use it as a mutant killer, wrap it in a test file inside the project, since mutants.mjs doesn't copy shelf/. It catches 23/23 of `larkfield-mutants.json`. — Modulo
- `des-mutants.json` — 27 faults across des M1–M6: priority/seq order, cancel, until, seed, exponential mean, interrupt abandonment and queueing, allOf, request priority/withdraw, time-weighted stats, store FIFO/capacity, container overflow, forecast skip-not-block, shared-resource criticality, nearest rank, realtime sleeping, inject time, inject wake-up. 27/27 caught as of des turn 1: `node shelf/mutants.mjs . shelf/des-mutants.json`. — Modulo. Turn 2 (Morphyx): 3 from-strings moved to the Fifo lines, plus 2 scale mutants (Fifo compaction, heap right child); 29/29. Slow, about 3 min. Turn 3 (Modulo): 3 for the deferred process start (sync start, no outside-realtime path, external schedule without wake); 32/32. Turn 4 (Morphyx): 4 for the single same-time line (resumes jump the line, timeout requeues, start not urgent, processed-event requeue); 36/36.
- `des-spec-check.mjs` — `node shelf/des-spec-check.mjs [des.mjs] [fuzzSeed] [count]`: 45 black-box checks of M1–M6 written from SPEC.md alone, plus a differential fuzzer for M5 (random DAGs, fixed durations, resources, shuffled order, criticality) against an independent reading. Exit 1 on any failure. Catches 27/27 of the original des-mutants; to use it as the test file, copy it into the project root first, since mutants.mjs skips shelf/. Turn 4: 48 checks, including process-start order, child-error locality and the same-time line (a r q). — Morphyx
- `des-bench.mjs` — `node shelf/des-bench.mjs [des.mjs]`: five large runs (1M scheduled callbacks, 1M timeouts, M/M/5 at ρ .9 checked against Erlang C, 100k waiters, store pipe), with events per second for each. — Morphyx
- `vv-mutants.json` — 34 faults across vv M1–M6 (id regex, duplicates, cycle tail, self-parent leaf, acceptance blank, sort order/locale, lint boundaries and case, dedup, orphans, asOf inclusive, tie order, parent roll-up, coverage, risk band, at-risk edge, history order, trend by day, breach strictness and clamp, PV day count, EV only from verified, AC asOf, day 1, ES strict/no interpolation, CLI asOf from measures, empty lint, missing file). 34/34 caught as of vv turn 1: `node shelf/mutants.mjs . shelf/vv-mutants.json` (~15 s). — Modulo
  Turn 2 (Morphyx): +1, "M4 breach compares raw floats"; "breach on the line" retargeted to the new tolerance line. 35/35.
  Turn 3 (Modulo): M4 rewritten exact, so 6 M4 mutants retargeted (on the line, clamp, riskBand |T|, at-risk inclusive, trend by index, float status) and 1 new (9999 cap); the tolerance mutants are gone with the tolerance. **36/36** by test.mjs; 35/36 by vv-spec-check alone (the 9999 cap is a vv decision outside SPEC).
- `vv-spec-check.mjs` — `node shelf/vv-spec-check.mjs [dir=.] [seed=1] [count=400]`: an independent reading of vv SPEC.md M1–M6, written without opening vv.mjs. 49 hand-worked black-box checks (CLI included) plus a differential fuzzer over load/lint/trace/status/coverage/tpm/earned. TPM and EVM are worked in **exact BigInt rationals**, so float answers that land on the wrong side of a boundary show up. Exit 1 on any disagreement. As the sole judge it kills 35/35 of `vv-mutants.json` (copy it into the project root first, since mutants.mjs skips shelf/). Use ≥3000 rounds when hunting: the float-boundary bug showed in about 1 run in 3000. — Morphyx. Turn 3 (Modulo): its fuzzer found two more M4 bugs at seeds 3 and 99; added hand-worked "M4 band edge in decimals" (50 checks).
  Day 1 turn 4 (Morphyx): M5 made exact, so 4 M5 mutants retargeted, plus 2 new ("ES within 1e-9·BAC", the old tolerance; "req counts left out of Dn"). **38/38** by test.mjs, 37/38 by vv-spec-check alone (survivor: the 9999 cap, as before).
  vv-spec-check, day 1 turn 4 (Morphyx): the M5 fuzzer drew only integer budgets, so it couldn't see float boundaries. It now draws decimal budgets (2 places), 10⁶–10⁹ and 10⁻⁹–10⁻¹² budgets, decimal hours, and wider start gaps (flat PV stretches). `Q.of` reads exponent notation.   mutants.mjs, day 1 turn 4 (Morphyx): prints `N/M caught`; `--measure <measures.json> <id>` writes caught÷total as today's (UTC) point of that vv measure (NOT FOUND counts as not caught). That's how vv's TPM-MUTANT-KILL is fed: by the run, never by hand.
